tests.scope: Root documentation and architecture only; desktop suite and native-window test not run.
tests.fullMakeTestAndBuild: Not run for artwork and documentation-only changes; no production or test wiring modified.

storage: All ten output PNGs are saved under the user's tabi-assets/train-actions and tabi-assets/scenario folders. Media stay local and uncommitted; only docs and checks are committed.
inspectionLimits: Page direction is visually inspected, not text recognition or automated art approval.
Full-scene image edits may change pixels outside the book; these are references for later aligned/masked preparation.
Panoramas are opaque single images with slightly different dimensions; no seam, depth-plane, 180-second or loop continuity is established.
scratchPolicy: Remove the unique task-owned temporary directory after preserving this evidence; do not remove existing artifacts, virtual environments, tool caches or generated-image originals.
